message.content:
This vertical, rectangular editorial illustration features two figures on a pale green-grey background. Above the main image, large grey letters spell out "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, the words "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appear in smaller grey type.

Two men sit facing each other, their bodies emerging from opposite sides of a large, grey, box-like object with a ballot box design. One man on the left has darker skin and wears a white, long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled up. He is lean and leans back on his right hand while his left arm is raised to grip the hand of the man on the right. The man on the right has lighter skin and a larger build, wearing a white short-sleeved button-down shirt and a black songkok cap. Both men have their hands joined in a high-five or arm-wrestling position. Their expressions appear jovial.

The box between them features a grey panel with printed lines and text that is partially obscured. Black text above the men reads "BENCI-RINDU DUA SETERU" and is followed by three lines of smaller black text. In the bottom left corner, there is a barcode, a date "24-30 JUNI 2019", and a price "RP 45.000". Small headers at the top read "KSAD TENTANG JENDERAL MENGANGGUR DAN RUSUH PEMILU" and "BARTER AUDIT PETINGGI BPK". A solid red band runs down the far-left edge.
